text: The flood warning for the St. Johns River near Cocoa in Brevard County is still in effect. At 7:15 PM Thursday the river stood at 16.9 feet, which is above the 16.0-foot flood stage and in moderate flood stage. NWS expects it to reach major flood stage late this week and stay there through the weekend and into early next week. Do not drive around barricades or through flooded roads near the river.

Update to the St. Johns River flood warning near Cocoa (9 miles west) in Brevard County: at 8:15 AM Friday the river stood at 16.9 feet, above the 16.0-foot flood stage, and moderate flooding is happening now. NWS now expects the river to keep rising, reach major flood stage this weekend and crest at about 17.1 feet late this weekend into early next week. The warning stays in effect until further notice. At 17.2 feet the Providence Road area west of Cocoa becomes impassable, cutting off access to the Mullet Lane and Bass Road area. Do not drive around barricades or through flooded areas, and use caution near the riverbanks.
